name: lilo
description: Manage your saved LILO locations and collections with your assistant.

interface.longDescription: Connect your LILO account to find and manage your saved locations, organize collections, read and edit supported profile fields, and export owned locations as a Lilopack. Actions use your granted permissions and existing LILO access rules. A LILO account is required. Photos can be uploaded to existing locations through a returned HTTP PUT URL or imported from a direct public HTTPS image URL. Creating locations from photos, nearby search, geocoding, and importing Lilopacks are not supported. Location exports exclude photos and collections.
defaultPrompt: Find my saved locations tagged cafe.
Show the places in my weekend collection.
